title: Relative Spec commutes with base change
statement: Let $g:S'\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal A$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-algebra (a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras whose underlying $\mathcal O_S$-module is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]), with multiplication $\mu:\mathcal A\otimes_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ (tensor product of modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]) and unit $e:\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal A$. Let $g^*\mathcal A$ be the pullback module [def-pc-module-pullback] with the multiplication $g^*(\mu)\circ t^{-1}:g^*\mathcal A\otimes g^*\mathcal A\to g^*\mathcal A$, $t:g^*(\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal A)\cong g^*\mathcal A\otimes g^*\mathcal A$ the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor], and the unit $g^*(e)\circ\epsilon_g^{-1}:\mathcal O_{S'}\to g^*\mathcal A$, $\epsilon_g:g^*\mathcal O_S\cong\mathcal O_{S'}$ the isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf]. Let $\pi:X=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)\to S$ with $\alpha:\mathcal A\cong\pi_*\mathcal O_X$ be the relative spectrum [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](2), and $X'=X\times_SS'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $\pi':X'\to S'$, $g':X'\to X$. Then: (1) $g^*\mathcal A$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebra, $\pi'$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras $\gamma:g^*\mathcal A\to\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$, namely the morphism corresponding under $g^*\dashv g_*$ to $\pi_*(g'^\sharp)\circ\alpha:\mathcal A\to\pi_*\mathcal O_X\to\pi_*g'_*\mathcal O_{X'}=g_*\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$. (2) Let $\rho:Y=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_{S'}(g^*\mathcal A)\to S'$ with $\alpha':g^*\mathcal A\cong\rho_*\mathcal O_Y$ be the relative spectrum of $g^*\mathcal A$ over $S'$. The canonical $S'$-morphism $\Phi:\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_{S'}(g^*\mathcal A)\to\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S(\mathcal A)\times_SS'$, i.e. the unique $S'$-morphism $Y\to X'$ with $\pi'_*(\Phi^\sharp)=\alpha'\circ\gamma^{-1}:\pi'_*\mathcal O_{X'}\to\rho_*\mathcal O_Y$ (the anti-equivalence of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec](3) over $S'$), is an isomorphism of schemes over $S'$.

proof.text: The pullback of the affine morphism pi is affine by Mathlib stable-under-base-change applied to sq. The unit module O_X is quasi-coherent. The affine pushforward base-change theorem makes beta an isomorphism, and the structure-sheaf comparison epsilon_{g'} is an isomorphism. Hence delta = beta followed by pi'_*(epsilon_{g'}) is invertible.

source.place: Lemma 02KG, applied to the structure sheaf

proof.text: Apply the proved structure-algebra pullback transport theorem to alpha and the invertible delta. Set A' to the actual structure algebra pi'_*O_X' and gamma to its identity isomorphism. Transport supplies hA', the genuine multiplication and unit, both transport identities, and the adjoint section formula. Quasi-coherence of A' follows directly from part (1) of the affine morphism/relative Spec theorem, since pi' is affine.

source.place: Section 01LQ, pullback algebra structures and adjunction; Cohomology Remark 08HY, canonical base-change comparison. Agent-written transport calculation, parent steps 2--3.

proof.text: For any affine rho:Y->S' and alpha':A' ≅ rho_*O_Y, lift the algebra isomorphism through the fully faithful functor of the affine-morphism anti-equivalence using preimageIso. Unop and forget to schemes to get Phi:Y->X'. The morphism is over S', and the equivalence's displayed section formula gives exactly the required appLE formula, cancelling the object identification isomorphisms. Functors preserve invertibility, so Phi is an isomorphism. For any other Psi with the same section formula, extensionality on section maps gives equal images under the functor; faithfulness yields Psi=Phi.
